s.note: Crisp Ukrainian grated potato and onion pancakes with sour cream and dill
s.how: Grate 800g potatoes and 1 onion, squeeze out the liquid hard and mix with 1 egg, 3 tbsp plain flour, salt and pepper. Fry heaped spoonfuls in 4 tbsp oil for 3 to 4 minutes a side until deep golden and crisp. Serve hot with 200g sour cream and chopped dill.

s.note: Crisp corn tostadas with raw tuna in lime and soy, avocado, chipotle mayonnaise and fried shallots
s.how: Dice 300g sashimi-grade tuna and toss with the juice of 1 lime, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil and sliced spring onion. Brush 8 small corn tortillas with oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp. Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Spread the tostadas with mashed avocado, top with the tuna, a little chipotle mayonnaise and 2 tbsp fried shallots.

m.note: Slow-cooked beef chuck chilli with chipotle, cumin, kidney beans and a little dark chocolate, with rice, sour cream and cheddar
m.how: Brown 800g diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp oil. Soften 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano and 2 tbsp chopped chipotle in adobo, then a 400g tin of tomatoes and 500ml beef stock. Simmer covered for 2 hours, add a 400g tin of kidney beans and 20g dark chocolate and simmer 20 minutes more. Serve over 300g steamed rice with sour cream, grated cheddar and spring onion.

w.note: Thin honey sponge layers stacked with whipped sour cream, left overnight to go soft, finished with honey crumbs
w.how: Melt 100g honey, 100g caster sugar and 80g butter over simmering water, whisk in 2 eggs and 1 tsp bicarb until foamy, then work in 350g plain flour. Rest 15 minutes, divide into 6, roll each thin to a 20cm round and bake at 180C for 6 minutes. Trim and crumb the offcuts. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 500g sour cream and 100g icing sugar, stack the layers with the cream, cover the cake and the crumbs and chill overnight.

d.note: Fresh watermelon blended with lime and a little sugar, strained over ice with mint
d.how: Blend 1.2kg seedless watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp caster sugar and 250ml cold water. Strain, chill and pour over ice with mint sprigs.
